supersedes.reason: versioned replacement closing the S1/S2 reproducibility findings without rewriting frozen v3

splits.train: global_splits.json:train; fit model and both normalizers only
splits.validation: global_splits.json:val; checkpoint selection and stopping only
splits.evaluation: global_splits.json:eval; locked until every arm and failure record freezes

rng_contract.pairing: same five seeds for every arm: initialization, minibatch order, rollout and bootstrap pairing
rng_contract.streams: derive independent train, rollout and bootstrap streams as SeedSequence(seed).spawn(3) in that order
rng_contract.determinism: torch float64 deterministic algorithms; no diagnostic rerun replaces a registered run

state_adapter.raw_coordinate: Segment.x[:,0] = parquet column x; column y is never read
state_adapter.normalization: pool all adapted train timepoints; coordinatewise mean and population std (ddof=0); fail if nonfinite or std<1e-8; reuse unchanged on val/eval and every arm

environment_feature.aggregation: arithmetic mean of finite solar_elev rows in the aligned window; day_fraction and every other column excluded
environment_feature.missing_policy: fail arm before fit if file/window/solar_elev is missing, empty or nonfinite; no imputation
environment_feature.normalization: fit scalar mean and population std (ddof=0) over train segments only; fail if nonfinite or std<1e-8; reuse unchanged on val/eval and all neural arms

neural_diffusion_contract.bridge_correction: a @ grad(log_h) in state order [X,V]; component 0 acts on X and component 1 acts on V

neural_architecture.activation: torch.nn.Tanh after each hidden Linear; no output activation
neural_architecture.initialization: all Linear weights xavier_uniform_ with calculate_gain('tanh'); all Linear biases zero
neural_architecture.drift_clip: elementwise clamp network drift to [-10.0,10.0] before NLL and rollout

i1.stopping: relative train NLL improvement <1e-5, otherwise max_iter; no validation tuning

neural.objective: one-step Gaussian NLL on normalized [X,V]: mean=z+(dt/60)b_clipped(z,e), covariance=(dt/60)diag(exp(2ell_X),exp(2ell_V))
neural.stopping: validation NLL patience=30 completed epochs and absolute min_delta=1e-5
neural.checkpoint: minimum validation NLL; exact tie goes to earliest epoch

rollout.I1: exact Gaussian transition kernel at each event-grid interval, left-to-right, using registered seed stream
rollout.neural: Euler-Maruyama in normalized [X,V], left endpoint coefficients, h=min(1.0 second, remaining interval), z_next=z+(h/60)b_clipped+sqrt(h/60)B epsilon, no adaptive stepping
rollout.time_grid: t_0=0; t_k=min(k*1.0 seconds,T), including t=0 and exact endpoint T

energy_half.failure: M<2 or any nonfinite state is metric failure

hdr90.density: 2D Gaussian KDE over M=1000 samples; sample covariance denominator M-1; Scott f=M^(-1/6); H=f^2*S+1e-9*I
hdr90.threshold: sort M leave-none-out KDE densities ascending; q=ceil(0.10*M); threshold=sorted[q-1]
hdr90.membership: closed rule density_H(y)>=threshold; ties inside; fail if H or density nonfinite/non-positive

event.hit_rule: E true iff closed-set X(t_k) in A at any registered point including t=0,T; never read velocity
event.histogram_rule: terminal state[0]=X only; searchsorted(edges,X,side='right')-1; X=8 belongs [8,+inf)

bridge_dual.bridge_correction_coordinates: a @ grad(log_h) acts state[0]=X then state[1]=V
bridge_dual.exclusion: boolean complement not E per path
bridge_dual.reconstruction: raw full-support bin counts including underflow/overflow; sum_j abs(p_recon_j-p_prior_j)<=1e-12
bridge_dual.strata: hit and non-hit counts positive; else undefined_stratum and never pass
bridge_dual.fp_mc_l1: analytic-prior versus Monte-Carlo error separately without 1e-12 tolerance

delta_probe.displacement: DeltaX_i=state_i[T,0]-state_i[0,0] on normalized train trajectories; never read state[1]
delta_probe.failure: nonfinite/zero sigma_hist or empty erosion is failure/NA; never replace delta

inference.bootstrap: hierarchical paired bootstrap B=2000: resample 5 seeds with replacement, then segment_id blocks within each selected seed; identical draws for all arms in contrast
inference.effect: right metric minus left metric; energy lower better; HDR signed error is coverage-0.90
inference.holm: within contrast family and metric: sort p; adjusted rank r cumulative max min(1,(m-r+1)*p_r)
inference.simultaneous_ci: theta_c +/- bootstrap 0.95 quantile of max_c abs(theta_b,c-theta_c) within family/metric

arm_results.rule: one row per key; energy/HDR only on base; dual/event on all directions; NA literal NA

contrast_results.rule: one row per registered contrast and metric with raw/Holm p and pointwise/simultaneous CI
